newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Widow of first S. African Nobel laureate dies.
newsitem.headline: Widow of first S. African Nobel laureate dies.

text.p: The widow of South Africa's first Nobel Peace Prize winner and former African National Congress (ANC) president Albert Luthuli died on Sunday, the African National Congress (ANC) said on Monday.
An ANC spokesman said Nokukhanya Luthuli, 92, died late on Sunday at her Groutville home on the KwaZulu-Natal north coast.
"The heart of a lioness has ceased to beat...The ANC dips its revolutionary banner to this great patriot, heroine and Titan," the party said in a statement.
Chief Luthuli received the Nobel Peace Prize in 1960, the year of the Sharpeville slaughter by police of 69 black protesters, an event which galvanised world opinion against apartheid.
